text.description_html:
Bommer BB5000-450H-652, 4-1/2" x 4-1/2" Hospital Tip Door Hinge with 2 Ball Bearings

The anti ligature hospital hinge tip makes this hinge great for use in detention centers, hospitals, and, medical facilities. Meets the requirements for institutional anti-ligature safety hardware. This 4-1/2 x 4-1/2 Hospital Tip Door Hinge with 2 Ball Bearings has a brushed chrome finish.

Medium duty door hinge, standard .134" thickness with 2 ball bearings. The steel hinge pins cannot be removed for security and safety.

Specifications for the Bommer BB5000-450H-652 Anti Ligature Hinge:

  • Brushed Chrome Finish
  • Height: 4-1/2"
  • Width: 4-1/2"
  • Corners: Square
  • Thickness: 0.134"
  • Wood Screws: #12 x 1-1/4"
  • Machine Screws: #12-24 x 1/2"
  • BHMA Certified Grade 1 for 1 million cycles.
  • Non-Handed
  • 2 Ball Bearings for Smooth Action
  • Anti Ligature Hospital Tip
  • Standard Template Hole Pattern
  • NRP Steel Hinge Pin
  • Conforms to ANSI A8112 for Ball Bearing Hinges

Package with matching finish machine screws and wood screws. For use with both metal and wood doors.

Sold Individually (1 door hinge)

** This item is being discontinued. Limited quantities available.
